# dyz-gongwen-skills

> AI Agent Skills for writing Chinese official documents (公文). 22 skills covering drafting, revision, review, and GB/T 9704 standard Word layout. Supports Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, Kimi Code CLI, Trae, and web chatbots (DeepSeek, Doubao, Kimi) via copyable prompts.

## What this project does

dyz-gongwen-skills is a collection of agent skills (also called prompts, slash-command skills, or coding-assistant plugins) that help users write Chinese official documents (公文, gōngwén). It enforces Chinese regulations and national standards (GB/T 9704-2012 layout, GB/T 15834-2011 punctuation, GB/T 15835-2011 numerals), adapts to the type of organization and the writer's role, is built to use only the materials the user provides (gaps are marked [TO FILL] rather than invented), is designed to stop and ask for confirmation when it detects classification markings, and cuts length rather than padding it.

## Document types covered

- Statutory documents (法定公文): notices, requests for instructions, single-issue reports, letters, circulars, replies, opinions, memos, decisions, announcements
- Comprehensive documents (综合文稿): work summaries, annual plans, research reports, performance reports, implementation plans
- Speeches (讲话稿): leader speeches, host scripts, addresses, experience-sharing remarks
- Party-building materials (党建材料): self-examination reports, Party-building work reports, Party class scripts, organizational-life records
- Meeting materials (会议材料): meeting minutes, records, agenda papers, follow-up lists
- Implementation and rectification (落实与整改): task breakdowns, rectification plans, ledgers (Excel export), self-inspection reports
- Information and briefs (信息简报): government information items, bulletins, press releases, official-account posts
- Data and charts (数据与图表): table checks, calculations, local Excel chart generation

## Industry packs (optional, install separately)

- gongwen-grassroots: townships, sub-districts, villages, communities
- gongwen-hospital: public hospitals (accreditation self-assessment, performance analysis, RCA/PDCA, department-head reports)
- gongwen-university: universities (audit self-assessment, discipline evaluation, grant-application form checks)
- gongwen-k12: primary and secondary schools (term plans, inspection self-assessment, parent-meeting speeches, student comments)
- gongwen-soe: state-owned enterprises (major-decision agenda materials, Party committee prior-review documents, compliance reports)

## Installation

Claude Code plugin marketplace:
/plugin marketplace add duyunzhoudyz/dyz-gongwen-skills
/plugin install gongwen@dyz-gongwen-skills

npx (Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, and others):
npx skills add duyunzhoudyz/dyz-gongwen-skills

One-click script (Windows): powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1
One-click script (macOS/Linux): bash install.sh

No-install (web chatbots and intranet models): copy prompt files from dist/prompts/

## Key facts

- 22 skills total: 17 core skills (Stable) + 5 industry packs (all Stable: grassroots, hospital, k12, university, soe)
- Benchmark (v1.0, 372 test cases, 2,671 checks): 99.1% pass rate on general checks vs 68.7% without skills; 0 fabrications in 136 anti-fabrication cases vs 66 without
- Competitive benchmark (compete-v7: 27 tasks, 276 runs, against 8 similar GitHub skills and a no-skill control; judged by two LLMs, not humans): best GB/T 9704 layout audit score (97.2 vs 79.6 for the best alternative); AI-tone removal keeps 99.6% of facts, with added facts in 1/16 runs (Claude judge) and 2/32 (DeepSeek judge). Details and limitations are in the README
- Platforms: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, Qwen Code, Kimi Code CLI, Trae, CodeBuddy, DeepSeek, Doubao, Kimi (web), intranet LLMs
- License: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 (free for personal/noncommercial use; commercial use requires authorization)
- Language: all skills, prompts and outputs are in Chinese; this project does not write English documents
